content: For a small marketing site's blog+pricing content, the ecosystem splits into (a) git-based/file CMS (Decap CMS style: content as markdown/YAML in-repo, no DB) and (b) DB-backed hosted CMS. Since this project already commits to Prisma-backed content editable via an internal admin UI (not git-workflow content editors), the relevant minimal pattern is a simple CRUD screen over DB tables (posts, pricing plans) with basic fields (title, slug, body, excerpt, category, published flag, ordering) -- not a general-purpose page-builder, versioning/workflow (draft->review->publish approval chains), or multi-content-type headless CMS abstraction, which are over-built for 2 content types with one internal editor persona (staff, not external content team).
